contrasts.name: H2 diffusion − BC-MLP
contrasts.reading: H2 diffusion − BC-MLP: separated (+) under both the bootstrap and the seed-level interval, with 6 seeds on 100 fresh starts. In this replication the difference does not rest on 3 seeds or on the 50 frozen starts. The frozen separation holds in this replication, now under both interval methods. Separate replication; the frozen result stands as reported.

contrasts.name: H2 diffusion − BC-RNN
contrasts.reading: H2 diffusion − BC-RNN: not separated under either interval, with 6 seeds on 100 fresh starts. This replication gives no evidence of a difference; that is not evidence of equality. As in the frozen result, not separated. Separate replication; the frozen result stands as reported.
